title: ExecutionAttempt
description: ENG-01 new contract. Source: SD work-execution-contract.md §2,§4,§6. One immutable record of a single dispatch/reconcile/verify I/O attempt against an ExecutionTask's fixed operation and business_key. A retry of the SAME ExecutionTask always creates a NEW ExecutionAttempt with an incremented attempt_no; it never allocates a new ExecutionTask (backlog ENG-01 acceptance: 重試只增加 Attempt). Uniqueness of (tenant_id, task_id, attempt_no) across attempts is checked by tests/domain_contract_test.py against the example fixture set and is an ENG-02 persistence-layer invariant (UNIQUE constraint) going forward.

ExecutionAttemptObservation.description: SD §2: timeout and late-arriving results each append a new observation; the original attempt record is never overwritten.

outcome.description: SD connector-result-and-reconciliation.md §3 OperationResult.status; capability support/unsupported is never recorded here (ADR 0002).

task_id.description: The one ExecutionTask this attempt belongs to. Never changes across the attempt's lifetime.

attempt_no.description: Monotonically increasing per task_id. (tenant_id, task_id, attempt_no) is unique; a retry increments this rather than creating a new task_id.

attempt_kind.description: SD §4: RECONCILE and VERIFY may only call capabilities already declared read-only; a provider 'lookup' that actually writes must be modeled as a DISPATCH under its own authorization, never hidden inside a reconcile call (SD-C-10).

fence_token.description: The lease fence held at the moment this attempt was made (SD §6.3); must not be reused once a later lease has superseded it.

request_hash.description: Must equal the owning ExecutionTask.request_hash for attempt_kind=DISPATCH; a changed hash means a new business request, not a retry of this attempt.

observations.description: Append-only sequence; once written, an attempt's prior observations are immutable (SD §2).
